# CreditFix Kit

DIY credit repair kit: a personalized PDF containing the 5 FICO score factors
translated to the buyer's situation, 3 mail-ready letter templates (bureau
dispute under FCRA Sec. 611, collector validation under FDCPA Sec. 809,
goodwill adjustment for late payments), and a 12-month month-by-month
rebuild plan adapted to the buyer's situation (collections / late-payments /
thin-file / mixed). A free score-factor explainer is available with no email
required. https://creditfixkit.mehyar.us/

## Key pages

- / — landing page with free teaser (score-factor explainer) and $47 checkout
- /success.html — post-Stripe confirmation; polls order status by token
- /deliverable.html — the buyer's private kit page (token-gated), PDF download
- /privacy.html — privacy policy
- /terms.html — terms of service

## Pricing

$47 one-time via Stripe, through the centralized
https://mehyar.us/api/pay/checkout (product_id "creditfix-kit"). No
subscription. The personalized PDF is the buyer's forever, including template
updates.

## API

- POST /api/creditfix/teaser — free: { situation, goal? } → score-factor
  explainer + locked letter previews. No auth, no email required.
- POST /api/creditfix/generate — paid: { order_token } → generated kit manifest.
  Gated on creditfixkit_orders.access_token. Idempotent.
- GET /api/creditfix/deliverable?token= — token-gated kit manifest JSON.
- GET /api/creditfix/pdf?token= — token-gated kit PDF download.

## Compliance

Educational information only — not legal or financial advice. The kit is not a
law firm, attorney, or certified financial planner. No guaranteed score
increases, no promised removal or correction of any specific item, no outcome
promises of any kind; results vary by file, creditor, and bureau. Buyers are
instructed to dispute only items they believe are inaccurate, incomplete, or
unverifiable, and to consider consulting a licensed attorney or certified
financial professional before acting, especially before paying or
acknowledging old debts.
